charge_port.notes: mbusa lists the DC connector as NACS.

supercharger_access.notes: mbusa NACS page: MY27 EVs have a NACS DC inlet and need no adapter at Tesla Superchargers (the G 580 itself is not named on that page).

wheels.notes: G 580 with EQ Technology. Carried from the 2026 (and 2025) G 580e pages (20 in); the 2027 Cars.com G-Class page names no G 580e wheel sizes, no page for this exact year opened.

heat_pump.notes: ArenaEV lists the G 580 EQ (2024-, open-ended) with Heat pump: Yes; the page shows 116 kWh usable while our 2027 data has 117 kWh, so the 2027 pack may have changed; nothing found about a heat-pump change. ArenaEV is a spec database with EU figures; "Yes" does not say standard or optional and no Mercedes US/CA page could be opened (media.mbusa.com 404; KBB, Cars.com, Green Car Reports silent). ArenaEV lists "Heat pump: Yes" without saying standard or optional (it also says Yes for the 2019–21 i3, where it was a paid option), and its pages mix EU data.
